decision.observation: The farmer is west of the upper bridge at a path junction; the dirt path continues west toward a north-south passage, while bushes block movement directly south.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing west to the open north-south passage, then heading south, should reach the lower town route to the beach.
decision.memory: One parsnip is planted and watered; 14 seeds remain. Willy has a gift at the beach. The upper bridge's eastern routes and the narrow strip south of it are dead ends; search west of the wooden planter.
